page_title: LIL 3-1 AUX | Lille v Auxerre 20/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+9' Thomas Leonard sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
90+9' The Lille players halt their celebrations as referee Thomas Leonard makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
90+7' 3 - 1 Goal! 3:1. Jonathan David (Lille) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
90+6' Auxerre have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+2' 2 - 1 Alexsandro (Lille) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him and his teammates, it's into his own goal!
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Ethan Mbappe (Lille) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
89' Auxerre earn a corner.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gaetan Perrin trots off the pitch and is replaced by Yoann Cisse (Auxerre).
86' Bruno Genesio has decided to make a change. Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) replaces Hakon Arnar Haraldsson.
86' We are about to witness a substitution. Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) is replacing Ismaily.
85' What a great touch by Jonathan David (Lille) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
84' Ismaily (Lille) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
81' The Auxerre players are exchanging some short passes.
80' That will be all from Andre Gomes who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nabil Bentaleb (Lille).
80' Chuba Akpom comes off the pitch to be replaced by Ethan Mbappe (Lille).
80' Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Assane Diousse.
79' Christophe Pelissier prepares a substitution. Gideon Mensah is replaced by Paul Joly (Auxerre).
77' Florian Aye (Auxerre) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
76' Neat passing move from Auxerre in order to create new attacking opportunities.
73' The percentage of ball possession is – 59:41.
71' That's the end of the game for Mathias Fernandez-Pardo, who is replaced by Osame Sahraoui (Lille).
69' The ball goes out of play. Auxerre are awarded a corner kick.
68' The Lille players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
67' Christophe Pelissier has decided to substitute Theo Bair and he is replaced by Florian Aye (Auxerre).
67' Substitution. Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) replaces Clement Akpa.
61' Booking. Han-Noah Massengo (Auxerre) receives a caution from the referee.
59' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
58' Jonathan David (Lille) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The ball is out of play and Lille manage to earn a corner.
57' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

56' The ball goes out of play and Lille have been awarded a corner kick. A long pass finds Ismaily (Lille), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the bottom right corner, but Donovan Leon reacts well to make a good save.
53' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
52' Auxerre are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
47' Jubal Junior (Auxerre) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

43' 2 - 0 Jonathan David (Lille) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight into the top left corner. He couldn't have done it any better. 2:0.
42' Jonathan David (Lille) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
41' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
40' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 6:1.

37' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
37' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
34' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
33' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
31' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

31' Chuba Akpom (Lille) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Donovan Leon. Corner kick. Lille will have an opportunity.
29' The cross into the penalty area from Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
25' Thomas Meunier (Lille) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
22' Bafode Diakite (Lille) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
21' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
19' Good work from Lille as they win a corner. Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
18' Han-Noah Massengo (Auxerre) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Lucas Chevalier is equal to it and makes an easy save.
17' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Auxerre.
12' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) will take the corner.

9' 1 - 0 Goal! Jonathan David displays great vision and sends a pass to Thomas Meunier (Lille), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:0.
7' The possession of the ball – 75:25.
5' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
5' Ismaily (Lille) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lille are going to take it.
4' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) takes the corner with a short pass.
1' Lille seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has just begun.
Lille will kick the game off.
Thomas Leonard is the one to supervise the game today.
